items.title: Russian drone strike on a Kharkiv-region park killed six, including three children (catch-up, Oct 19)
items.summary: A Russian Geran-3 drone struck the central park of Nova Vodolaha, Kharkiv Oblast, around 16:30 local on Oct 19 while families with children were there. Six killed, including three children; 15 injured including seven children. Zelensky named one victim as Anhelina, just over a year old, killed in her stroller (her mother Inna died in hospital); another killed girl was 11. A cafe near the park was damaged; the Kharkiv Regional Prosecutor opened a war-crimes investigation. Governor Syniehubov and Interior Minister Vyhivskyi reported the figures on Telegram; the event was missed by the Oct 20 resumed-watch catch-up.

items.title: 22 bipartisan House lawmakers urged Trump to revoke the Russian diesel licence (catch-up, Oct 15)
items.summary: A bipartisan group of 22 House lawmakers (five Republicans) wrote to Trump, Rubio and Bessent urging full implementation of the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act and revoking Treasury General License 135, the Oct 9 Russian-diesel authorisation. Escalation from the Oct 13 12-senator letter; the White House defended the deal (Newsweek: it would 'increase global supply and lower prices'). Trump issued the Graham-Act waiver EO the following evening, Oct 16. Missed during the watch pause.
